title: El Compromiso de Lagunillas, MEXITV
comment: compromiso-lagunillas (MEXITV): jardín frontal de una hacienda junto a la laguna de San Pedro Lagunillas, Nayarit, por la tarde. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.LAZARO_UGALDE: Mexican man, proud and feared hacienda owner, 66 years old, tanned skin, short grey hair, a thick grey mustache, bushy eyebrows, stern dark eyes, a white guayabera shirt, beige trousers, a brown leather belt with a silver buckle, a cream palm hat, his hands empty.
chars.ESTELA_UGALDE: Mexican woman, the hacienda owner's wife, 61 years old, fair skin, shoulder-length auburn-dyed hair in soft waves, gentle sad hazel eyes, a lilac long-sleeve blouse, a long cream skirt, a thin gold chain with a small medal, her hands empty.
chars.MARCELO_UGALDE: Mexican man, the hacienda owner's son, 30 years old, light-brown skin, short dark-brown hair with a side part, clean-shaven, a determined look, a light-blue button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, chinos, his hands empty.
chars.CAROLINA_BENAVIDES: Mexican woman, daughter of the rival family, 27 years old, warm olive skin, long straight black hair with a center part, large hazel-green eyes, a coral sleeveless summer dress with a white cardigan, small gold stud earrings, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_JARDINLAGUNILLAS: Front garden of an old hacienda by the lagoon of San Pedro Lagunillas, Nayarit, in the warm late afternoon: green lawn, tall royal palms, a white hacienda facade with arches and a red tile roof, terracotta pots with hibiscus, the calm lagoon and green volcanic hills behind, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
